description: Look up a public IP: AS, country, cloud provider, CDN, datacenter, Tor exit, crawler, DROP listing and PTR name. A Pro key with its own Shodan or AbuseIPDB key adds exposure and reputation. For every prefix of the AS, call asn_lookup.

ip_address.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address, such as 8.8.8.8 or 2001:4860:4860::8888

name: ip_lookup

asn.description: The AS of the IPtoASN prefix that holds the address. null when no prefix holds it or the list is not loaded. asn_name and asn_country are then null too.

asn_country.description: The two-letter country where the AS is registered. null when IPtoASN names none.

asn_name.description: The name IPtoASN gives the AS.

cloud_provider.description: The cloud or CDN provider whose published range holds the address, such as aws. null when no range holds it or the ranges are not loaded.

cloud_service.description: The service of that range, such as ec2 or cloudfront.

crawler.description: The crawler list whose range holds the address, such as googlebot. null when no list holds it or the lists are not loaded.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

geo_country.description: The two-letter country of the address, from DB-IP Lite. null when no prefix holds the address or the list is not loaded.

internet_exposure.description: The Shodan slot, filled with the caller's own stored key. Its forms are as in reputation. available true adds source and the members from ports to last_update.

last_update.description: When Shodan last updated the host. null when it gives none, and always for shodan_facets.

source.description: shodan for the host query. shodan_facets for the count query that a free Shodan key gets.

tags.description: The labels Shodan gives the host.

vulns_truncated.description: true when shodan_facets cut the CVE list at its limit, so Shodan may hold more. Always false for shodan.

is_cdn.description: true when the cloud range that holds the address belongs to a CDN, false when it does not. null when no range holds it or the ranges are not loaded. An address of no range can still be a CDN edge.

is_datacenter.description: true when a cloud range or a datacenter AS holds the address. false only when IPtoASN and the cloud ranges are both loaded and neither matches. null when it is not true and either is not loaded.

is_ptr_forward_confirmed.description: true when an A or AAAA record of ptr holds the address. false when every forward question was answered and none of the first 10 PTR names maps back. null when ptr is null or a forward question failed.

is_tor_exit.description: true when the Tor Project's exit list holds the address, false when it does not. null while the list is not loaded.

listed_on.description: DROP prefixes that hold the address, the longest first. [] when none holds it. null while the list is not loaded.

copyright.description: The copy text of that file. The list asks that it stays with the data.

list_time.description: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ of the file that listed the prefix.

listing_id.description: The id of the prefix's record in the list.

prefix.description: The listed prefix in CIDR form.

ptr.description: A PTR name of the address. It is the first of the first 10 names whose A or AAAA record holds the address. When none does, it is the first name. null when there is none or the question failed.

reputation.description: The AbuseIPDB slot, filled with the caller's own stored key. available true adds source and the report members. available false adds reason and the members that reason names.

abuse_confidence_score.description: AbuseIPDB's confidence that the address is abusive, from 0 to 100.

action_tool.description: privacy_my_data, the tool whose answer holds the link that saves vendor keys. Present for vendor_key_missing and vendor_key_rejected.

action_url.description: The page that fixes the reason. Present for pro_key_required, vendor_key_missing and vendor_key_rejected.

available.description: true when the slot holds the vendor's answer.

distinct_reporter_count.description: Different reporters that sent those reports.

is_whitelisted.description: null when AbuseIPDB does not say.

last_reported_at.description: When the last report came, as AbuseIPDB writes it. null when it gives none.

reason.description: Why the slot is empty: pro_key_required (no Pro API key), vendor_key_missing (no stored key for this vendor), vendor_key_rejected (the vendor refused it), vendor_unavailable or database_error.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds the vendor asked to wait. Present only for vendor_unavailable when the vendor gave a wait.

total_reports.description: Reports AbuseIPDB holds for the address.

usage_type.description: The usage type AbuseIPDB gives, such as Data Center/Web Hosting/Transit. null when it gives none.

unavailable.description: Each key names a part that could not be answered. A list that is not loaded gets not_synced under the first field of its group. asn also stands for asn_name and asn_country, and cloud_provider for cloud_service and is_cdn. {} when every part answered.

is_ptr_forward_confirmed.description: Present when ptr has a name, no name maps back and a forward question failed. The code says why the first failed one failed. It is server_error, truncated, malformed_answer, no_memory, timeout or no_resolver.

ptr.description: Present when the PTR question failed. The code says why. It is server_error, truncated, malformed_answer, no_memory, timeout, no_resolver or not_public_name. A name that does not exist is no failure.

title: IP Lookup
